summary: All 4 S1 reorder holes (eps 4-7) promoted to full anchors with own start chapters — no zone_level_only needed. The early-S1 weave is simpler than feared: each episode is 2-3 whole-chapter segments from vols 2-3, monotonic within eps 4, 5, 7; only ep6 airs out of manga order (29 before 27). Evidence: fandom episode infoboxes + chapter-page reverse maps (all 9 chapter pages walked, every one round-trips to its episode), independently confirmed by MangaDex's chapter title/volume data — every segment equals a titled chapter 1:1 (School, Deskwork, House-hunting, Super Powers, Beach, Comiket, Dodgeball, Saikawa-san, Lucoa's Family) — plus AnimeVice's separate wiki explicitly mapping ep6 to ch 29 with matching segment order, and a MAL ep5 thread confirming the three-chapter structure. Continue point is 12 for all four episodes (differs from END+1 in every case): frontier logic — eps 1-2 cover chs 1-9 (ep1=1-4, ep2=5-7+9, both verified this batch), ch 10 parked to the OVA, ch 11 in ep3 — matching the stored ep3 and ep8 continue→12 convention exactly. Stored types need no correction: ep4/ep6 [mixed] confirmed (anime-original shopping expansion; Fafnir-Takiya home-life segment), ep5/ep7 [canon] confirmed (scene additions only). No repairs; ja per-episode sources are season-level only and namu.wiki (the one candidate explicit table) is bot-blocked.

anchors.note: Two segments: ch 13 'Kanna and School' (v2; school-supplies shopping trip is an anime-original replacement of ch 13's paperwork scene per fandom trivia) then ch 21 'Tooru and Dodgeball' (v3; trivia notes the cut magic-shell plot point). Fandom infobox + both chapter reverse maps; MangaDex titles/volumes independently confirm both segments 1:1. Monotonic within the episode; the reorder is vs neighbors (ep3 ends on 8, ep5 returns to 14).

Three segments in order: ch 14 'Tooru and Deskwork' (office observation), ch 15 'Tooru and House-hunting' (Fafnir moves in with Takiya), ch 18 'Tooru and Super Powers' (ESP/spoon-bending) — all v2. Fandom infobox + reverse maps on chs 14/15/18; MangaDex titles confirm each segment 1:1; MAL discussion independently confirms the episode 'mashed three chapters'. Skips 16-17 (saved for ep7).

NON-MONOTONIC in-episode order: ch 29 'Kanna and Saikawa-san' (home visit, Georgie debut in both) then ch 27 'Tooru and Lucoa's Family' (Lucoa/Shouta, Shouta debut in both); closing Fafnir-Takiya home-life segment is anime-original (fandom trivia + AnimeVice both). AnimeVice's separate wiki explicitly lists ch 29 and matches the segment order; fandom infobox + both reverse maps; MangaDex titles/volumes (both v3). END = 27, last mainline in running order.

Two segments: ch 16 'Tooru and the Beach' (Lucoa/Shouta added to the beach cast — anime addition, Shouta post-dated ch 16 per fandom trivia) then ch 17 'Tooru and Comiket' — both v2. Fandom infobox + reverse maps on chs 16/17; MangaDex titles confirm both segments 1:1. Backfills the 16-17 pair skipped by ep5.

continue_points.note: END+1 would be 22 (already aired in ep3). Frontier: eps 1-3 covered 1-9, 11, 22 (+40 elements); ch 10 parked to the S1 OVA per the ruled convention; earliest not-yet-adapted-but-will-be mainline = 12 (adapted in ep12). Matches stored ep3/ep8 continue→12.
END+1 = 19 is real future material (ep13 adapts 19-20) but ch 12 is the earlier unadapted mainline chapter — frontier stays 12.
END+1 = 28 (later adapted in ep12's dream segment); frontier stays 12.
END+1 = 18 already aired in ep5; frontier stays 12 (ch 12 lands in ep12, per the stored convention).

annotation_updates.note: Early-S1 zone facts, now exact: eps 4-7 are whole-chapter segment episodes from vols 2-3 (ep4: 13,21; ep5: 14-15,18; ep6: 29,27 — non-monotonic in-episode; ep7: 16-17). No Kanna-spinoff or other spinoff chapters appear anywhere in eps 4-7 — the only spinoff grafts in S1 remain the ep11 setting inspirations already ruled non-adaptations. Anime-original content: ep4 shopping expansion, ep6 Fafnir/Takiya closer; eps 5/7 scene-level additions only.

flags_for_sean: Confidence grading note: the per-episode chapter lists are stated explicitly by one wiki (maid-dragon fandom, infobox + per-chapter reverse maps all mutually consistent), with independent confirmation coming from MangaDex's title/volume data matching every segment 1:1 (Dodgeball/Comiket/Beach/School/Deskwork/House-hunting/Super Powers/Saikawa-san/Lucoa's Family) and, for ep6, a second wiki (AnimeVice) stating ch 29 + the same segment order. I graded these high because every member chapter is independently confirmed and the episodes are clean whole-chapter adaptations with full segment accounting — unlike batch 15's medium-graded eps 3/12 where partial/'elements' adaptation left completeness uncertain. Downgrade to medium if you want 'two explicit statements of the full list' as the hard bar.

namu.wiki has a per-episode 'Episode Guide' page (en.namu.wiki .../에피소드 가이드) that likely tabulates S1 episode→chapter mappings explicitly, but namu.wiki 403-blocks all fetch paths tried (ja/en mirrors, browser UA). If a settling source is ever wanted for this zone, that page is the candidate.
